{
  "source": "/revit/tool-registry",
  "ranking_version": "operator.tool_search_ranking.v3",
  "query": "place face-hosted or ceiling-hosted duct terminal family instance at model point with host resolution",
  "total_matches": 6,
  "matches": [
    {
      "method": "POST",
      "path": "/revit/create-family-instance",
      "group": "Modeling",
      "risk": "high",
      "title": "Create Family Instance",
      "description": "Place one or more family instances. Supports symbolName or typeName alias, optional levelName, target view/sheet placement (viewId|sheetNumber), spacing arrays (count + spacingX/Y/Z), rotationDegrees, and dryRun.",
      "required_fields": [
        "x",
        "y",
        "z"
      ],
      "optional_fields": [
        "familyName",
        "symbolName",
        "typeName",
        "levelName",
        "viewId",
        "sheetNumber",
        "count",
        "spacingX",
        "spacingY",
        "spacingZ",
        "rotationDegrees",
        "dryRun"
      ],
      "score": 446
    },
    {
      "method": "POST",
      "path": "/revit/place-families",
      "group": "Modeling",
      "risk": "high",
      "title": "Place Families",
      "description": "Batch place family instances from a spec. Resolve the type by stable familySymbolId or familyName/symbolName. ViewBased symbols require viewId and use Revit's view-owner overload; apply fails closed unless readback proves the exact owner view, target-view collector membership, and a view-specific bounding box. Results include type, owner-view, requested and actual location, collector, and bounding-box evidence. For unhosted non-view-based instances, coordinateMode:absolute_model corrects any family-origin/level offset after creation and fails closed unless LocationPoint readback matches the requested XYZ exactly within tolerance. Non-view-based placement supports default levelName, optional per-instance levelName override, parameters, exact user-workset assignment by worksetName or worksetId, and explicit allowUnhostedWorkPlanePlacement for project-approved unhosted work-plane families. For a linked ceiling, wall or floor, provide hostElementId for its RevitLinkInstance and linkedHostElementId for the exact linked element; linked-face placement checks both native host identities and the projected model-space point after regeneration. Unhosted work-plane placement is not a substitute for a requested ceiling host. Body: {familySymbolId?|familyName?,symbolName?,viewId?,levelName?,worksetId?,worksetName?,allowUnhostedWorkPlanePlacement?,dryRun?,bestEffort?,instances:[{x,y,z,coordinateMode?:absolute_model,levelName?,rotationDegrees?,hostElementId?,linkedHostElementId?,parameters?}]}.",
      "optional_fields": [
        "levelName",
        "viewId",
        "familySymbolId",
        "familyName",
        "symbolName",
        "worksetId",
        "worksetName",
        "allowUnhostedWorkPlanePlacement",
        "instances",
        "dryRun",
        "idempotency",
        "behavior"
      ],
      "score": 324
    },
    {
      "method": "POST",
      "path": "/revit/create-similar-from-instance",
      "group": "Modeling",
      "risk": "high",
      "title": "Create Similar From Instance",
      "description": "Create one or more hosted copies from an exemplar instance, preserving hosting behavior, orientation, and the exemplar workset with native verification while supporting exact host slots via wall-chainage or explicit point placements plus preview. Optionally match the source exemplar's electrical circuit. Before apply, inspect the source exemplar and include any instance parameters that drive visible tags or schedules in parameterNamesToCopy; geometry, host, and circuit agreement alone do not prove annotation fidelity. Body: {exemplarElementId,hostElementId?,roomId?|roomNumber?,roomSide?,referenceElementId?,alongHostOffsetsFt?|placements?,matchOrientationFromSource?,orientationSourceElementId?,copyRotation?,copyFacingHandState?,matchElectricalCircuitFromSource?,requireElectricalCircuitMatch?,parameterNamesToCopy?,parameterOverrides?,dryRun?,includePreviewImage?,previewViewId?,previewImageSize?,focusPaddingFt?}.",
      "required_fields": [
        "exemplarElementId"
      ],
      "optional_fields": [
        "hostElementId",
        "roomId",
        "roomNumber",
        "roomSide",
        "referenceElementId",
        "alongHostOffsetsFt",
        "placements",
        "levelName",
        "matchOrientationFromSource",
        "orientationSourceElementId",
        "copyRotation",
        "copyFacingHandState"
      ],
      "score": 138
    },
    {
      "method": "POST",
      "path": "/revit/open-family-doc",
      "group": "Modeling",
      "risk": "high",
      "title": "Open Family Doc",
      "description": "Open a family document for editing. Prefer {titleblockInstanceId} for titleblocks in the active model. Body: {filePath? | familyId? | titleblockInstanceId? | elementId?}. Returns docId (session handle).",
      "optional_fields": [
        "filePath",
        "familyId",
        "titleblockInstanceId",
        "elementId"
      ],
      "score": 124
    },
    {
      "method": "POST",
      "path": "/revit/inspect-family-content",
      "group": "Query",
      "risk": "low",
      "title": "Inspect Family Content",
      "description": "Read-only inspection of any editable loaded family from a grounded project FamilyInstance. Opens the family internally, inventories static TextNotes, parameter-driven Label elements, nested family/annotation instances, family parameters, and bounded class/category counts, then always closes without saving. Body: {elementId,contains?,maxElements?,includeParameters?,includeOtherElements?}. Use this before deciding whether visible text is fixed, parameter-driven, or nested; it never edits or reloads the family.",
      "required_fields": [
        "elementId"
      ],
      "optional_fields": [
        "contains",
        "maxElements",
        "includeParameters",
        "includeOtherElements"
      ],
      "score": 110
    },
    {
      "method": "POST",
      "path": "/revit/plan-family-evolution",
      "group": "Modeling",
      "risk": "low",
      "title": "Plan Family Evolution",
      "description": "Read-only, fail-closed plan for cloning a selected loaded family, creating a type with exact width/depth, and optionally adding a light symbolic clearance rectangle. Requires immutable instance/family/type identity, fingerprints family content, and resolves side=power_connection only from one electrical connector close to an equipment edge. Body: {instanceId,expectedUniqueId,expectedMark?,expectedFamilyName,expectedTypeName,newFamilyName,newTypeName,widthParameterName?,depthParameterName?,width,depth,clearance?:{side,offset,lineStyleName?,linePatternName?,lineWeight?,red?,green?,blue?},familySavePath?}.",
      "required_fields": [
        "instanceId"
      ],
      "optional_fields": [
        "expectedUniqueId",
        "expectedMark",
        "expectedFamilyName",
        "expectedTypeName",
        "newFamilyName",
        "newTypeName",
        "widthParameterName",
        "depthParameterName",
        "width",
        "depth",
        "clearance",
        "familySavePath"
      ],
      "score": 110
    }
  ]
}
